90	def report(root, packet_path, asset_id=None, path="plar.txt"):
91	    from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
92	
93	    from .plar_prepare import SCHEMA, _artifact, _json_file, _require
94	
95	    root = Path(root).resolve()
96	    packet, digest, packet_path = _json_file(root, packet_path)
97	    _require(
98	        type(packet.get("version")) is int and packet["version"] == 1,
99	        "expected request-review version 1",
100	    )
101	    _require(isinstance(packet.get("sources"), list), "packet sources must be a list")
102	    sources: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
103	    for source in packet["sources"]:
104	        _require(
105	            isinstance(source, dict) and {"path", "sha256", "role"} <= source.keys(),
106	            "packet sources need path, sha256 and role",
107	        )
108	        name = graph.confined(root, source["path"]).relative_to(root).as_posix()
109	        _require(
110	            name not in sources or sources[name]["sha256"] == source["sha256"],
111	            "conflicting source identities",
112	        )
113	        sources[name] = source
114	    pointer = packet.get("request")
115	    _require(
116	        isinstance(pointer, dict) and pointer.get("kind") == "provider_arguments",
117	        "review expects exact provider arguments, not a creative brief",
118	    )
119	    request, request_hash, request_path = _artifact(root, packet.get("request"))
120	    connection = None
121	    if "connection" in pointer:
122	        value, connection_hash, connection_path = _artifact(root, pointer["connection"])
123	        connection = {
124	            "path": connection_path,
125	            "sha256": connection_hash,
126	            "provider": value.get("provider"),
127	            "discovery": value.get("discovery"),
128	            "authorization": value.get("authorization"),
129	        }
130	
131	    plan, plan_hash, plan_path = _artifact(root, packet.get("criteria"))
132	    error = next(Draft202012Validator(SCHEMA).iter_errors(plan), None)
133	    _require(error is None, f"candidate plan: {error.message if error else ''}")
134	    evidence, comparisons, diagnostics = [], [], []
135	    if (
136	        connection
137	        and "provider" in pointer
138	        and pointer["provider"] != connection["provider"]
139	    ):
140	        diagnostics.append(
141	            {
142	                "status": "provider_mismatch",
143	                "packet": pointer["provider"],
144	                "connection": connection["provider"],
145	            }
146	        )
147	
148	    source_bindings = []
149	    for source in packet["sources"]:
150	        local = graph.confined(root, source["path"])
151	        name = local.relative_to(root).as_posix()
152	        observed = (
153	            graph.file_hash(local)
154	            if local.is_file() and local.stat().st_size <= 64 * 1024 * 1024
155	            else None
156	        )
157	        status = (
158	            "current"
159	            if observed == source["sha256"]
160	            else "changed"
161	            if observed is not None
162	            else "unavailable"
163	        )
164	        source_bindings.append(
165	            {**source, "observed_sha256": observed, "binding": status}
166	        )
167	        if status != "current":
168	            diagnostics.append({"source": name, "status": status})
169	        pointers = [source] if "locator" in source or "lines" in source else []
170	        locators = source.get("locators", [])
171	        if isinstance(locators, list) and all(
172	            isinstance(value, str) for value in locators
173	        ):
174	            pointers.extend({**source, "locator": value} for value in locators)
175	        else:
176	            diagnostics.append(
177	                {"packet_source": name, "status": "unresolved_locator_format"}
178	            )
179	        for citation in pointers:
180	            item = source_evidence(root, citation, source["sha256"])
181	            if item not in evidence:
182	                evidence.append(item)
183	            source_bindings[-1].setdefault("source_evidence", []).append(
184	                evidence.index(item)
185	            )
186	            if item["status"] != "resolved":
187	                diagnostics.append(
188	                    {
189	                        "packet_source": name,
190	                        "locator": citation.get("locator"),
191	                        "status": item["status"],
192	                    }
193	                )
194	
195	    for output in plan["outputs"]:
196	        for criterion in output["criteria"]:
197	            indices = []
198	            for source in criterion["sources"]:
199	                name = graph.confined(root, source["path"]).relative_to(root).as_posix()

arguments.description: One static 16x16 pixel-art UI Ready status icon conveying successful completion: visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms. Transparent background. Readable silhouette at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on dark navy #172336. Use the existing UI cool blue accent direction; #70b9ed is a color cue, not an exact required palette. Deliberate clean pixel clusters and edges. No fixed palette or binary-alpha restriction. Proposed representative sample before expanding the Working, Retry and Paused family; no approved style reference exists yet.

Family distinction (Working/Retry/Paused versus Ready), renderer integration of statusCell/compactStatus, the style-approval decision and destination acceptance remain later-stage obligations recorded in request-review.json and PLAR, not rejection rules for this sample.

requirements.name: transparent-background
requirements.check: The background is transparent: pixels outside the subject have alpha 0 and no opaque matte, box or fringe fills the cell. Partial alpha on subject pixels is permitted; binary alpha is not required.

Done. The PHASE.md reassessment stage is complete and `HANDOFF-RESULT.json` is saved at the consumer root.

**What happened**

- One native PIXL specialist (agent type `pixl`, loaded via the `pixl:pixl` skill) reassessed the delivered Ready fixture and its retained contract. It viewed the retained native, 3x and derived grayscale views, consulted the bundled pixel-art methods, measured the artifact, and wrote a corrected future contract in `work/queue.ready-reassessment/`.
- I independently compared that corrected packet against BRIEF.md, both source files, the Start vector and the stage files. Verdict: consistent. My review is `work/queue.ready-reassessment/caller-review.json`. No discrepancy needed a round trip to the specialist, so none was sent.
- The specialist saved an exact resumable handoff via `pixl_plar_handoff` at `.pixl/handoffs/193d9714….json`. Its resume block matches the fresh focused PLAR read. HANDOFF-RESULT.json links that handoff and my comparison.

**Defects found and corrected in the new artifacts** (ledger entries C01 to C18)

- Citation: over-broad line bounds on every historical criterion, two unresolved named locators, and an out-of-range OWNER.md citation. All replaced by per-line bounds I verified against the numbered files. The corrected packet gets zero request-review diagnostics.
- Contract: a mixed mechanical/visual transparency criterion was split into two routes. The word "dominant" in the accent rule was demoted from owner requirement to a scoped specialist proposal. The ready-meaning wording no longer bakes the delivered 1:2 arm construction into the rule. Stale resume and obligation text now reflects that the image exists and the destination is delivered.
- The dropped seventh criterion (grayscale silhouette) was judged justified by both of us, since the brief binds non-colour distinction on Retry and Paused, not Ready alone. It is retained as a non-rejecting diagnostic with measured luma.

**Pixel-art reasoning in brief.** At 16x16 on the dark panel, 3-pixel runs on exact 45-degree diagonals give a roughly 2 px stroke that reads at 1x and enlarges to clean blocks at 3x. The 1:2 arm ratio makes it read as a check, not a V. Contrast against the panel is high enough that form, not hue, carries identity. Expert choices, not owner rules: Ready as the sample, blue as primary fill, stroke weight, flat single tone, no plate.

**Preserved.** All historical contracts, verdicts, the nominated candidate, PX2 state (revision 14, unchanged) and provider history were re-hashed after every write and are byte-identical. PLAR changed only in hash-safe fields (evidence and next); requirements hash and selection binding are unchanged, with prior bytes in `.pixl/plar-history/`. No provider tool was called.

**Still open.** Style/family adoption and source-binding of a baseline, a graphical renderer for display acceptance, Working/Retry/Paused production under new authorization, and a deliberate future PLAR requirements revision to refresh the stale hash-covered row text.
